<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that converts an aldehyde (e.g., acetaldehyde) back to an ester, matching the DIBAL-H reduction transformation (break ester, form aldehyde and aliphatic hydroxyl).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ester"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehyde", "aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
